title: Main game states
description: main.gd's state variable. Pause and help are flags inside play, not states.

states.description: The title card over a rival-against-rival match on a fully revealed island; a finished match is replaced by a new one after four seconds.
A match against the rival at the chosen difficulty; the player's input acts on the world.
The end screen shows victory or defeat; the simulation stops.
Test mode: rivals play both sides and balance is logged.

transitions.action: Generate a new island and start the match.
Show the end screen with the match statistics.
Start a new match at the same difficulty.
